VerifyEmail.subject: 3ook.com Account Verification
VerifyEmail.body:
To register your 3ook.com account, please click the button below to verify your email address.

Verify

If you did not register for a 3ook.com account, please ignore this email.

success.title: Email verified
success.body: Your email address is confirmed. You can close this window.

failed.title: This link is no longer valid
failed.body: The verification link has expired or has been replaced. Sign in and request a new one.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We could not verify your email just now. Please open the link again in a moment.
